answer: Counterparty diversity stops clone farms. An identity earns nothing until it trades with twelve distinct partners over ten epochs: a lone tree in an orchard bears no fruit, and a ledge of self-dealing accounts cannot pass. Each trade must move five units, so forging 1,000 clones costs 1,000 x 12 x 5 = 60,000 units against a 50-unit reward. Honest agents pay the threshold once, keep their full share, and trade in an oasis of diverse partners.
